trainers.lead: Who prepares and teaches the courses.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Use the form below and tell us which course interests you.
how.step2Text: The course starts with sessions led by a trainer. At that point, we email you a personal invitation to create your account.
how.step3Text: The platform holds up to a month of materials to review and put into practice what you saw in the sessions. Access is for you alone.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find your answer here? Ask us through the <link>information request</link>.

experience.question: Do I need any experience with AI?
experience.answer: Not for the Introductory level: it starts from scratch. The Advanced level does assume some experience; contact us to find out more.

bring.question: What do I need to take part?
bring.answer: Just a laptop and, ideally, a paid subscription to an AI assistant: Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, whichever you prefer.

freeTier.question: Can I take part without a paid AI subscription?
freeTier.answer: Yes, but it is not ideal: you won't get as much out of the tools. Subscribing for one month, as a trial, is more than enough.

duration.question: How long does a course last?
duration.answer: It depends on the level. An Introductory course is usually a 4-hour session, followed by a month of materials to consolidate what you learned.

where.question: Where are the sessions held?
where.answer: The first sessions take place at Mindera's office in Porto. We are considering other locations depending on interest, so tell us where you are when you request information.

language.question: What language are the sessions in?
language.answer: They can be in Portuguese, English, or both (if any participants need it). The materials are always available in both languages.

price.question: How much does it cost?
price.answer: €80 if you sign up on your own. If you sign up as a group, the price goes down with the number of participants.

private.question: Can you run a private session for my team or organisation?
private.answer: Yes, we put together private sessions. In that case the price no longer depends on the number of participants, but on your requirements and the outcomes you want.

materials.question: Do I get access to the course materials?
materials.answer: Yes. Each participant gets their own access to the materials, for one month after the sessions.

certified.question: Is the trainer certified?
certified.answer: Yes. Pedro Vicente holds the CCP (Certificado de Competências Pedagógicas), the Portuguese certification for trainers.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.description: How the platform handles personal data.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: {name} is run by <link>Mindera</link> (Mindera Group), which is responsible for the personal data collected on this site. For any question about your data, write to the Mindera data protection officer at <email>dpo@mindera.com</email> or by post to Rua Gonçalo Cristóvão, 347, 4.º piso, sala 404, 4000-270 Porto, Portugal.

data.title: What we collect
data.text: When you request information: your name, your email and, if you give them, your organisation, the course you are interested in and your message. When you have an account: name, email, preferred language, the courses you are enrolled in and which of their materials you opened, and when. Trainers see this, to follow how the course is going. We do not collect browsing data for advertising and we use no third-party analytics.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.text: To answer your request, send you an invitation and give you access to the materials of your courses. We do not sell your data or pass it on for other purposes.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We only use the cookies the site needs to work: to keep you signed in and to remember the language you chose. We use no advertising cookies.

thirdParties.title: Content from other services
thirdParties.text: Some materials are YouTube or Vimeo videos, or Google documents. That content is only loaded when you choose to open it; from then on the privacy policy of that service also applies.

storage.title: Where it is kept
storage.text: The data is kept on Supabase servers in Ireland, in the European Union, with access restricted to the trainers and to the Mindera team that runs the platform.

retention.title: For how long
retention.text: We keep information requests and account data for one year.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw your consent, by writing to the contact above. You can also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in Portugal, the CNPD).
